credits.title: Malvada
credits.overview: A desperate mother contacts his son's ex-girlfriend to tell her that he's about to marry a wicked witch.

credits.title: Guie’dani’s Navel
credits.overview: Guie’dani, a Zapotec indigenous girl and her mother take up work with an upper-class family in Mexico City. The girl does not fit and is conflicting. Everything changes when she meets Claudia, a rebellious girl with whom she becomes close friends.

credits.title: Arrhythmia
credits.overview: Karl, a university professor, suffers of arrhythmia. The beatings of his heart mark the coordinates of a place, to where he must go. There, he faces his past.

credits.title: Olimpia
credits.overview: The film tells the story of Raquel, Rodolfo and Hernán, members of a brigade at the UNAM during the student movement in Mexico in 1968. Through their photographs, films and writings, we will know the history of the day that the army took the university and how their students united, shouted and never forgot.

credits.title: A Separate Wind
credits.overview: Omar (15) and Karina's (12) mother has a stroke during the family holidays. The siblings, drifting apart, will start a long journey through Mexico towards their grandmother's house. On the road they will face a broken and divided country. Where mistrust, resentment and violence are everywhere. Diverse characters -stran
